versions.content: This profile depicts one configuration and usage of the JasPar counter base FV with Master-Slave Synchronization method. It uses the CMAC algorithm based on AES-128 according to NIST SP 800-38B Appendix-A to calculate the MAC. Use the 4 least significant bits of the freshness value as truncated freshness value and use the 28 most significant bits of the MAC as truncated MAC. Freshness Value provided to SecOC shall be constructed as described in the [UC_SecOC_00202]. The profile shall be used for CAN.
